harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Added a persistent 600 MiB disk-backed swap file on node1. It activates at boot with priority 32767, above the existing swap priority of -1. Persistence was verified after a full node restart; CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Set ownership to root:root and permissions to 0600.
Initialized and activated the swap file.
Validated fstab activation using swapoff followed by `swapon -a`.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the swap file automatically recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MiB of disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: The swap file is 629,145,600 bytes; the explicit post-restart assertion confirms it exceeds 512 MiB.

evidence.requirement: New swap is preferred over all existing swap
evidence.summary: The new swap priority is 32767, while the maximum priority of every other active swap area is -1.

evidence.requirement: Swap is configured for boot activation
evidence.summary: The fstab entry was installed, validated through `swapon -a`, and remained effective after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.

Baseline boot ID was 67950f06-8de6-4ade-8000-000000000000; the reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 1f1caab8-ad40-4880-8000-000000000000; post-restart output directly confirms both swap areas, priorities, file metadata, memory health, persistent configuration, and kernel swap activation messages.
